title: Everything on the Wall
caption: Part 3: everything you can do on the Waypoint Wall, on the real screens. Mira shows it.
linkedin_text: Part 3 of the Waypoint tour: sorting the Wall, the surprise post and search, feeling filters, reactions, translate, Moments, deleting your own post, sharing as a picture, the Leaderboard and What's new.

scenes.vo: Hi, I'm Mira. Part three: everything on the Wall.
scenes.sub: Hi, I'm Mira. Part three: everything on the Wall.

scenes.vo: Switch between New, and Top today, this week or this month.
scenes.sub: Switch between New, and Top today, this week or this month.

scenes.vo: Tap the dice for a surprise post, or search from two letters.
scenes.sub: Tap the dice for a surprise post, or search from two letters.

scenes.vo: Filter the Wall by feeling: frustrated, anxious, lonely and more.
scenes.sub: Filter the Wall by feeling: frustrated, anxious, lonely and more.

scenes.vo: Tap a reaction under a post, and its author gets a notification.
scenes.sub: Tap a reaction under a post, and its author gets a notification.

scenes.vo: Not your language? Tap Translate, or turn on Auto-translate.
scenes.sub: Not your language? Tap Translate, or turn on Auto-translate.

scenes.vo: Moments: a picture that one person sees once, then it is gone.
scenes.sub: Moments: a picture that one person sees once, then it is gone.

scenes.vo: You can delete your own post, and it leaves the Wall at once.
scenes.sub: You can delete your own post, and it leaves the Wall at once.

scenes.vo: Share a post, your Break Room score or your Daily Path as a picture.
scenes.sub: Share a post, your Break Room score or your Daily Path as a picture.

scenes.vo: Points rank everyone daily on the Leaderboard, with Gold and Silver tiers.
scenes.sub: Points rank everyone daily on the Leaderboard, with Gold and Silver tiers.

scenes.vo: And What's new tells you what changed.
scenes.sub: And What's new tells you what changed.

scenes.vo: Waypoint. Say it once. Free on Google Play, in many Indian and international languages.
